verdict.summary: The round-2 approval remains supported. All six display slices publish unconditional totals computed only after row validation and before capping, and the browser renders a note only for non-negative integer totals greater than the actual displayed length. The executed DOM fixture covers over-cap, under-cap, legacy, malformed, fractional, and empty-lane states, while separately confirming that widening the health-card gate preserves defer and exit content. Expected values and fixture sizes are literal rather than derived from production caps, so the assertions are non-vacuous. I found no correctness, soundness, security, or test-validity issue in the diff.
